title: Differential alternative splicing in plant spaceflight transcriptomes: rMATS analysis of NASA OSDR RNA-seq data with machine learning and ontology integration
description: This deposit contains the complete analysis pipeline and results for differential alternative splicing (AS) analysis of plant RNA-seq studies from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR). We analyzed 8 proof-of-concept studies (7 Arabidopsis thaliana, 1 Brassica rapa) covering spaceflight, microgravity, Mars gravity, fractional gravity, simulated GCR radiation, and lunar regolith conditions. Across 199 samples and ~100,000 total splicing events, retained intron events dominated (57-67%) with 79-86% NMD sensitivity. Cross-study recurrence identified 93 genes significant in >=2 studies, with AT4G17310 significant in 4 studies spanning gravity, radiation, and regolith stressors. Differential splicing was quantified with rMATS-turbo v4.3.0 (FDR<0.05, |dPSI|>0.1). Machine learning (7-study LOSOCV classification, nested k-fold CV, UMAP clustering, SHAP feature importance) was applied to a 199-sample x 9,875-gene PSI feature matrix. Functional annotation used GO and MapMan bins. NMD susceptibility was predicted for all significant events. SpliceGrapher v0.2.7 was used for splice graph visualization.
